---
title: "quarto-index per-document state, rich fixture"
# Smart typography is off for the same reason every other probe turns it off:
# the marks below are compared byte for byte between two renders, and a
# rendered curly quote would be one more thing standing between the emitted
# output and the state that produced it.
from: markdown-smart
filters:
  - index
  - ../tests/state-pollute.lua
---

# What this fixture is for

Every mutable module-level cell the filter's passes share is meant to start
each document empty. This fixture is one half of the evidence: it is rendered
twice off one tree, once with the pollution filter above switched on and once
with it off, and the two renders' output and warnings must agree byte for
byte. Each mark below exists so that one cell's leak, and only that cell's,
moves something the comparison can see.

The pollution filter is listed after the extension in both renders, so its
presence is not what differs between them — only its environment switch is.

# The marks

**A range end the filter refuses**, written first so that it holds the
document's first range position with nothing planned at it:
[Refused]{.index range="middle"}. A leaked verdict planted at that position is
read by the emitting pass and turns this into a range opening.

**A declared sort key.** [Alpha]{.index sort="alpha-key"} files under a key
the author wrote.

**A term with no sort key of its own.** [Solo]{.index} files under its own
printed text, so a leaked key for that path changes what this mark emits.

**A key this document contests itself**, a locator mark and a cross-reference
on one entry: [Gamma]{.index} discussed here, and [Gamma]{.index see="Alpha"}
pointing elsewhere.

**A key this document does not contest.** [Held]{.index} is marked one way
only, so a leaked contest for it changes the shape this mark emits.

**A cross-reference target nothing indexes.**
[Beta]{.index see="Nowhere"} draws the dangling-target report, which a leaked
path set silences.

**A four-level entry the LaTeX fold clamps.**
[Deep]{.index entry="L1!L2!L3!L4"} prints three levels and files under the
path this back-end prints.

**A principal mention.** [Pivot]{.index mention="principal"} registers an
ordinal, which a leaked registry or a leaked counter both move.

**A paired range**, from [Span]{.index range="open"} here through to
[Span]{.index range="close"} here, which a leaked position counter unpairs.

::: {.qi-index-here}
:::

Prose after the marker, so the index has something to sit in front of.
